title: Performance -- where it stands
thesis: One of the most complete and rigorous planes in the library -- P0-P11 all shipped, 366 assertions -- it closes the OTel triad (metrics + traces + logs, all in native OTLP JSON) and exposes Prometheus text, and adds SLA judgment with edge-triggered alerting, a sampling profiler, queueing-theory capacity analysis and a driven-load harness, in one coherent plane. Its real signature is measurement discipline: clocks as scopes, Windows 15.6 ms quantization handled, self-cost priced, and a rule that unmeasured is an error, never a silent pass. What it is not, by design, is the storage-and-dashboard half.

lanes.note: Counters/gauges/timers and Prometheus-style labeled families with the child registry engine-side; cardinality bounded at birth with a counted overflow child.
Two independent engines: an O(1) log-bucket sketch and sort-exact nearest-rank over the window; histogram_sum keeps an exact lifetime sum so the mean is exact.
Prometheus text (PromText) and OTLP JSON for metrics, spans and logs; built-in GET /metrics + /health; pull (scrape) and push (OTLP) both present.
stzSla verdicts in the unified rule shape into stzRuleReport; stzPerfSentinel edge-triggered OnBreach/OnClear with a flight recorder; NOT-MEASURED is an error.
Clocks as scopes, Windows 15.6 ms quantization handled, SelfCost() priced (~0.03 ms), exact-transfer proven against frozen stubs, the self-check identity law.
stzPerfProfile: utilization, throughput, service demand, MaxThroughput, Headroom, Bottleneck split, memory trend, Little's law with an independent self-check.
W3C traceparent spans, parent->child join, engine trace circular buffer, OTLP resourceSpans export; propagation at the HTTP seam only, one global scope, drop-oldest circular buffer.
Inside stzTraceScope every stzLog record stamps a traceId; OfTrace(id) recovers a trip's lines; OTLP logs export; one global scope slot.
Observe/ObserveRoutes wrap the appserver seam recording the well-known subjects; stzStopwatch brackets any operation; manual, no auto-instrumentation.
stzProfiler over an engine frame stack plus a real engine sampler thread, folded flamegraph output; cooperative Enter/Leave frames, not native stack unwinding.
stzPerfPlan: a closed catalog an LLM may propose, only an effectful actor may ExecuteOn; stzLoadDriver measured X sub-linear and R super-linear on a real fleet.
Bounded in-memory rings hold the recent window; no time-series database, no PromQL, no dashboards -- export-only by explicit design.

standouts: Closes the OTel triad (metrics + traces + logs) and exposes Prometheus text, in one plane
Measurement discipline: clocks as scopes, Windows 15.6 ms quantization handled, self-cost priced with its own machinery
Unmeasured is an error, never a silent pass
Queueing-theory capacity analysis with independent self-checks (utilization, Little's law)
gaps: Auto-instrumentation (zero-code, opt-out rather than opt-in Observe)
Full trace-context propagation (baggage, async-context through reactor jobs, per-task scopes)
Head/tail trace sampling; in-process aggregation (PromQL-lite); native-stack profiling
A storage/dashboard integration story; macOS RSS; one stale CLAUDE.md metadata line (P0-P7 / 283 vs P0-P11 / 366)
